item.title: Documentary about Ukraine wins International Emmy; producer cites ‘unvarnished’ look at war
item.description:
Editor's note: this story was translated from the original VOA Ukrainian article.
A documentary by the British channel Sky News about Ukrainian defenders, "24 Hours in the Kill Zone," has won an International Emmy Award.
In an interview with VOA, the film's producer Azad Safarov said, "We managed to show people during the war. It’s not about the shelling or the gunfire. It’s about the human story of the war — what ordinary people go through. After all, the majority of our service...
item.author: webdesk@voanews.com (Mariia Prus)

item.title: China extends suspension period for its ban on export of critical minerals to US
item.description: China has extended for another two months its suspension of a ban on exports of several critical minerals to the United States, a move analysts say roughly aligns with the timing of the current U.S.-China trade truce.
item.author: webdesk@voanews.com (VOA Mandarin)

item.title: UN warns Afghan women face deepening risks on the international day for the elimination of violence against women
item.description: The UN urged governments and donors to increase support for Afghan women's organizations, describing them as an essential lifeline for women and girls living under mounting social, economic and humanitarian pressures.
item.author: webdesk@voanews.com (VOA Afghan)

item.title: Iraqi Kurdistan faces renewed pressure on its autonomy from Baghdad and Tehran
item.description: Iraq’s Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has ordered federal authorities to take control over all border crossings in the semi-autonomous Kurdistan Region and to manage oilfields under Kurdish security control in four provinces, a move Kurdish leaders rejected as unconstitutional.
item.author: webdesk@voanews.com (Samira Ali Mandi, Snur Karim)

item.title: Switzerland Sanctions North Korean Camp Over Role in Transfer of Ukrainian Children
item.description: North Korea is threatening to close a recently opened Swiss diplomatic office in Pyongyang after Bern joined sanctions that Britain and the E.U. have imposed on North Korea's Songdowon International Children's Camp.
item.author: webdesk@voanews.com (Jinwoo Cho)

item.title: UN condemns Taliban’s treatment of Afghan women, calls it ‘femi-genocide'
item.description: In an interview with VOA, Reem Alsalem, the U.N. special rapporteur on violence against women and girls, said the scale and severity of policies imposed since the Taliban returned to power in August 2021 represent an unprecedented assault on the rights, dignity and humanity of Afghan women.
item.author: webdesk@voanews.com (VOA Afghan)
